summary: P1 Statement Decoder refresh + P2 accessibility/technical verified on web preview. H1 'Decode Your Support at Home Statement: Free to Try' renders from ToolHero. The new static inline sample (decoder-sample-output) renders with badge, three fee tiles ($890/$0/$890), 4-row line-item table, 'Everything checked out' + 'One thing to know' notes, and both CTAs (decoder-sample-decode-cta -> #decode, decoder-sample-trial-cta -> /signup?plan=solo). '120 days' copy is consistent on decoder page, homepage StatementDecoderEmbed, tool plan badge ('1 free decode every 120 days · Unlimited with a Wayly plan'), and the article. No forbidden 'per month' / 'free decode a month' / 'first decode each month' strings on any tested page. Homepage embed rendered and ran the sample with zero React 'unique key prop' console warnings. Heading hierarchy: /for-gps goes H1->H2->H2->H3->H3->H3->H2 (no skip), /resources goes H1->H2(Articles)->H2(Glossary)->H2(Templates)->H2(Where to Start)->H3s (cards promoted to H2 as required), /resources/templates goes H1->H2->H3. Canonical on decoder page points to prod (https://wayly.com.au/ai-tools/statement-decoder) and no stray noindex. One note: Google Ads gtag.js (AW-18544177324) DOES load on the preview host; this is distinct from a GTM container (no GTM-XXX found) but main agent should confirm this is intended since the request said 'GTM must NOT load' on preview.
